title: Parse the ledger line
prompt: Implement `parse(String line)` in the provided skeleton: split on `|` into exactly 4 fields; return `new Transaction(date, label, Direction.valueOf(field.toUpperCase()), Double.parseDouble(amount))`. The record's compact constructor already validates - let its exceptions propagate unchanged (callers need the real reason).

tests.name: valid lines parse
tests.hint: split("\|") - the pipe is a regex metacharacter and must be escaped.

tests.name: bad lines throw the record's exception
tests.hint: Don't catch inside parse - the constructor already throws the right thing.
